MemoryIgnoredEntry.description: Something in the memory folder that is not a memory file of its layout.

path.description: The path relative to the memory folder, with `/` separators.

reason.description: Why it is not a memory file.

description.description: The memory's description; absent for an invalid file.

group.description:
The machine of a `machine://` memory or the project of a
`project://` one.

invalid.description:
Why the file is not a valid memory; search and the snapshot skip it
until it is fixed.

orphaned.description: An `agent://` file whose agent the agent registry no longer has.

revision.description:
The first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the file's bytes; a write
or delete sends it back.

MemoryLayer.description: What a memory is about (`docs/site/specs/memory.md` section 4).

oneOf.description: `agent://<agent>`: one agent's way of doing its job.

description:
The memory files asked for, valid or not, and what else lies in their
folders.

ignored.description:
Entries of the memory folder that are not memory files of its
layout, by path; search and the snapshot never read them.

memories.description:
Memory files in layer order (`user`, `agent`, `machine`, `project`),
then by URL.
